whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cafe Meet-Up,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.8★ reviews in Mithapur, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page for new customers.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, aur special event inquiries integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cafemeetup

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Cafe Meet-Up, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and menu showcase for your location near NIFT College in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
